Package index

UniProt

Retrieving and reshaping UniProt records.

get_UniProt_data()
Download UniProt data for given protein accessions and data fields (see available fields with UniProt_fields())
get_UniProt_data_o()
Download UniProt data for given protein accessions, taxonomy identifiers and data fields (faster for 1000s of proteins; see available fields with UniProt_fields())
get_UniProt_data_1o()
Download UniProt data for given protein accessions, multiple taxonomy identifiers and data fields (faster for 1000s of proteins; see available fields with UniProt_fields())
UniProt_fields()
Return list of vectors of UniProt data fields

Plotting helpers

The EMBL palette and axis helpers. Colour meanings are fixed per project in 00_Setup.R, so these give the palette rather than hardcoded hex.

scale_color_embl()
ggplot2 'color' color palette based on EMBL colors from https://www.embl.org/guidelines/design/design-guidelines/colours/
